title: EATF Trust Anchors — trust-list.json schema
description: Schema for the canonical trust-list.json that lands in the github.com/tyche-institute/eatf-trust-anchors mirror. Phase 1 step 1.7 of the EATF roadmap. The mirror itself is principal-action (a GitHub org-level repo creation outside the autonomous-implementation surface); this schema + a seed manifest let consumers reference the format today.

version.description: Monotonically increasing manifest version. Bumped on every key ceremony.

spec.description: Stable identifier of the spec the manifest claims to conform to.

generatedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of manifest generation.

previousManifestSha256.description: SHA-256 of the previous trust-list.json. Empty string on the genesis manifest. Forms a hash chain so a mutation in the middle of the history is detectable by anyone walking from genesis.

anchors.description: Chronological list of all EATF signing-key public anchors. Append-only — never delete an entry, only flip its `retiredAt`.

kid.description: Stable identifier matching the kid stamped on attestations and ledger blocks via FileKeyProvider / Pkcs11KeyProvider.

algorithm.description: Algorithm identifier. RSA-XXXX or ML-DSA-65 in v0.1.

publicKeyPem.description: PEM-encoded SubjectPublicKeyInfo for the public key.

fingerprintSha256.description: Uppercase colon-separated SHA-256 of the SubjectPublicKeyInfo DER bytes. Matches the format used by the verifier SDK's DIGICERT_ROOT_FINGERPRINTS table.

validFrom.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when this anchor went into active production rotation. The first key ever used gets the EATF system epoch.

retiredAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when this anchor was retired (rotation, compromise, or wind-down). Absent for the currently-active anchor.

signedByPreviousKidBase64.description: Base64 RSA-4096 signature over the SHA-256 of this anchor's publicKeyPem, produced by the previous active key. Forms the chain of custody. Empty string for the genesis anchor.

ceremonyLogPath.description: Relative path inside this repository to the markdown ceremony-log produced when this anchor was generated. For audit-trail traversal.

notes.description: Optional free-form notes (e.g. 'rotation prompted by ceremony schedule, no security incident').
